milestones.title: Human test and operator validation
milestones.proof_description: Operator runs the full pipeline end-to-end, reviews the directory output against expected behaviour, and records a structured validation outcome with pass/fail notes per area.

milestones.title: Supabase schema baseline and migration tool
milestones.proof_description: Fix the auto_directory_category schema drift that causes every Supabase upsert to fail with PGRST204. Use scripts/apply_schema_migration.py to detect and apply all missing columns to the live cs_vendors table. Prove that check_supabase.py passes cleanly with no missing columns and that a vendor upsert succeeds end-to-end.

milestones.title: LLM extraction persistence fix
milestones.proof_description: Fix the gap where LLM extraction runs but structured fields do not write to Supabase. Run the enrichment pipeline on a set of 5 real vendors and prove that lifecycle_stages, use_cases, icp_buyer, and pricing are populated in cs_vendors after the run.

milestones.title: Discovery quality filter
milestones.proof_description: Add a vendor quality filter to the discovery phase that rejects non-vendor URLs (blog posts, review articles, error pages, Reddit threads, aggregator sites). Run discovery and prove the seed list contains only real vendor domains.

milestones.title: Apify web scraper enrichment
milestones.proof_description: Replace plain HTTP enrichment with Apify Website Content Crawler as the primary enrichment path. Run enrichment on 5 JS-heavy vendor sites (including at least one that currently returns empty fields due to bot-detection) and prove structured fields are populated in Supabase.

milestones.title: Full pipeline operational proof
milestones.proof_description: Run the complete pipeline end-to-end. Prove at least 20 real vendor records in Supabase with an average of fewer than 5 empty enrichment fields, a clean seed list with no non-vendor records, and a valid directory_dataset.json export ready for the public frontend.
